overall_assessment: All 28 fetched courses were read in full (7 suspects and 21 controls), and the additional failed-fetch entry was reviewed: visible substantive sections are captured with readable structure and no demonstrated navigation contamination. All seven short flags reflect source-page shells with no omitted plan prose; the discontinued-course 404 does not demonstrate a malformed URL. Five 2019 random controls return a current 2026/27-labelled plan, although existing downstream version checks withhold these later plans, and two controls duplicate their introductory paragraph.

findings.evidence: Bacheloroppgaven skal utgjøre et selvstendig utviklingsarbeid, utredningsarbeid eller mindre forskningsarbeid.
findings.description: In two random controls, the complete introductory paragraph between the course code and Beskrivelse av emnet is repeated verbatim as the first paragraph under that heading. Both copies enter extracted_text, unnecessarily weighting the same course-content prose twice. This is duplication within a course, which the cross-code dup_code flag cannot detect. Other introductions, such as SPD1001 and CDE911, contain distinct information and should be retained.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The Nord div.node__content selector includes both div.placeholder-text and the description accordion. The template repeats the same prose in both locations, and no Nord fulltext post_fn removes an identical introduction.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a Nord fulltext post_fn that compares the complete introduction after the course code with the initial paragraph under Beskrivelse av emnet, normalizing whitespace only, and removes the introduction when they are exactly equal. Preserve distinct and merely similar introductions.
